ZenCharge Core – Bamboo Wireless Charger with Phone Stand & Clock (15W Fast Charging)

The ZenCharge Core Wireless Charger with Table Clock Bamboo  is a premium modern desktop accessory designed for users who value style, sustainability and efficiency. Made with eco-friendly bamboo, this 15W wireless charger offers fast, reliable charging while doubling as a practical phone stand, metal pen holder and digital clock—all in one elegant unit. It is the perfect addition to any work desk and an excellent choice for corporate gifts and employee welcome kits.

Premium Bamboo for Office & Home

Crafted from natural bamboo, the blends seamlessly with any workspace. Its smooth finish, sturdy build and multifunctional design make it a stylish desk accessory for professionals, executives and tech-savvy users. The integrated phone stand keeps your device upright for easy viewing during video calls, notifications and multitasking.

15W Fast Wireless Charging for All Compatible Devices

The Core delivers up to 15W fast wireless charging for smartphones that support Qi. Whether you’re working, attending a virtual meeting or relaxing at home, this fast wireless charger ensures your phone stays powered throughout the day without messy cables. The stable charging pad and smart protection technology prevent overheating and ensure safe charging.

All-in-One Desk Organizer

In addition to being a powerful Core features a high-quality metal pen holder to keep your essentials within reach. The built-in digital clock adds convenience, making it a complete desk organizer for productivity-focused users. Its thoughtful design enhances both aesthetics and functionality, making it a top pick for corporate gifting and brand promotions.

Why is the Ideal Corporate Gift

Companies looking for premium corporate gifts often choose products that are both useful and memorable. The Core ticks all the boxes. With its eco-friendly bamboo design and multifunctional utility, it stands out as a modern, thoughtful and high-value gifting option. Its universal compatibility makes it ideal for employees, clients and partners across industries.

Key Features

  • Eco-friendly premium bamboo body
  • 15W fast wireless charger compatible with major smartphones
  • Integrated phone stand for hands-free viewing
  • Metal pen holder for organized workspace
  • Digital clock for added desktop convenience
  • Perfect for home, office, and corporate gifting
  • Minimalistic and premium design
